CustomField.description: This field displays a flag based on the Case received date.
CustomField.formula: IF( TODAY()- DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)<=2, IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif","/s.gif",26,20), IF( TODAY()- DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)<=10, IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_yellow.gif","/s.gif",26,20), IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_red.gif","/s.gif",26,20)) )
CustomField.label: Hardship Status
